metadata.name: portfolio_factory
metadata.description: Pool registry, creation policy and curator model for composable portfolios

instructions.name: accept_fee_recipient
docs: Completes it once the accountant's cooldown has run. The proposed
recipient must sign.

accounts.name: caller
docs: The proposed recipient. Signing here is the proof that the destination
is controlled — the half that used to live on propose.

instructions.name: accept_portfolio_treasury
docs: Anyone finishes a treasury rotation after the accountant cooldown.

instructions.name: activate_portfolio
docs: Re-verifies every structural invariant and sets the portfolio Live.
Transaction 3 of 3. One page of remaining-accounts per ix.

instructions.name: add_pool_cctp_destination
docs: Authorizes a CCTP mint recipient on a pool escrow. Governance only.

instructions.name: apply_targets
docs: Applies an effective composition change and prunes zeroed positions.
One page of remaining-accounts per ix; last page commits.

accounts.name: custodian
docs: canonical custody ATAs.

instructions.name: bind_pool_adapter
docs: First Active binding with no cooldown (pool create / extras).

instructions.name: cancel_targets
docs: Curator or guardian clears a pending change inside its notice window.

instructions.name: claim_core_admin
docs: Claims a core program's admin for `factory_authority`. Permissionless:
it only succeeds if the core already named the factory as incoming.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless: the claim proves nothing about the caller, only that the
core already named `factory_authority` as its incoming admin.

instructions.name: close_apply_scratch
docs: Closes a leftover `apply_scratch` PDA without deserializing it.
Required after the `started_slot` layout change: old accounts cannot
load as `Account<ApplyScratch>`. Cancel any in-flight apply first.

accounts.name: apply_scratch
docs: (Anchor `close` requires `Account<T>`, which would deserialize).

instructions.name: close_pending_targets
docs: Creator or governance: close an empty leftover `PendingTargets` PDA
after the last create/apply page.

instructions.name: close_pool
docs: Governance: close a Halted pool registry PDA.

instructions.name: close_portfolio
docs: Governance: close a sunset portfolio header. Remaining targets PDA
must already be gone.

accounts.name: remaining_targets
docs: `PendingTargets` PDA still owned by this program is not empty.

instructions.name: create_pool_vault
docs: Creates a pool's zero-fee accountant and its vault, ready to register.

accounts.name: escrow_asset_manager
docs: The escrow that will execute for this pool. It becomes the vault's asset
manager, because a pool is where the real execution happens.
directions before the pool can be used.

accounts.name: accountant_shares_account
docs: The pool accountant's shares account.
Fees are zero here, so it should never hold a balance — but the core's
`deposit` reads it unconditionally, so a pool without one refuses every
allocation (F12).

instructions.name: create_portfolio
docs: Creates a portfolio's vault, accountant and custodian. Transaction 1
of the three-step creation flow. Empty `targets` writes the header
only; legs follow on `create_portfolio_page`.

accounts.name: custodian
docs: against the vault below.

accounts.name: vault
docs: from the core's `next_vault_index`; the seed derivation is re-checked
here so a stale index fails rather than creating the wrong account.

accounts.name: accountant
docs: same way from the accountant config's next index.

accounts.name: stoken_config
docs: vault address. Validated by the CPI.

instructions.name: create_portfolio_page
docs: Packet-safe create: one `PAGE_LEGS` chunk per ix against a draft
header (`create_portfolio` with empty targets). Last page inits
`PositionPage`s and sets `leg_count`. Remaining on intermediate
pages is this chunk's pools; last page is the full pool set then
uninitialized page PDAs.

instructions.name: disable_pool_adapter
docs: Governance: disable an Active pool adapter (`factory_authority` signs).

accounts.name: inflight_bridge
docs: Passed through so this crate compiles against the current escrow pin;
M-4 accounting itself is P3.

instructions.name: init_escrow_token_account_2022
docs: Token-2022 custody ATA on an escrow (pre-registration; N159).

instructions.name: init_pool_adapter_registry
docs: Governance: init the pool escrow's AdapterRegistry (`factory_authority` signs).

instructions.name: init_pool_escrow_token_account
docs: Creates a per-mint custody ATA on a pool's escrow. Governance only —
the escrow manager is `factory_authority`, so this is the only path.

accounts.name: token_account
docs: the right space when the CPI `init`s it.

instructions.name: init_portfolio_shares
docs: Creates the shares mint and the accountant's shares ATA. Transaction 2
of 3. The two vault ATAs are a keeper step against the core, because the
core requires the vault's manager or processor to sign them.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Any caller. `factory_authority` pays for what is created.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Creates `FactoryConfig` and the system-owned `factory_authority` PDA.

accounts.name: factory_authority
docs: Created by hand for the same reason as the custodian: it pays for every
account creation during portfolio creation, and the System Program only
moves lamports out of accounts it owns that carry no data.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: Upgrade-authority gate. Prevents a watcher from initializing a fresh
deployment with hostile keys.

instructions.name: migrate_factory_config
docs: Permissionless realloc of `FactoryConfig` to `8 + INIT_SPACE`.

instructions.name: migrate_portfolio_header
docs: Permissionless realloc of a `Portfolio` to `8 + INIT_SPACE`. No-op when
the account is already current (fresh deploy). Appended last so existing
instruction discriminators stay put.

instructions.name: pause_creation
docs: Guardian or governance may set the creation pause.

instructions.name: pause_keeper_risk
docs: Guardian or governance may set the keeper-risk pause. It blocks
deposits, allocation, unwinds and fees — never fulfilment or return.

instructions.name: pause_pool_escrow
docs: Guardian or governance halts a pool's escrow. Adds the pause-only
guardian authority the escrow program itself lacks.

accounts.name: pool
docs: The registered pool, which is what binds this escrow to the catalogue.
Pausing an unregistered escrow is not this program's business.

instructions.name: probe_pool_custody
docs: One-base-unit Token-2022 custody probe; writes escrow `CustodyReadiness`.

accounts.name: probe_authority
docs: Owns the probe ATA (usually governance).

instructions.name: propose_core_admin
docs: Hands a core program's admin somewhere else. The escape hatch that keeps
the global admin from being trapped behind a factory upgrade.

instructions.name: propose_curator
docs: Two-step curator transfer: the incoming curator must sign.

instructions.name: propose_fee_recipient
docs: Hands a portfolio's creator fee stream to another address. The current
recipient proposes; the incoming recipient accepts after the cooldown.

accounts.name: current_recipient
docs: The address currently receiving the creator's share.

accounts.name: new_recipient
docs: signs `accept_fee_recipient`.

instructions.name: propose_targets
docs: Proposes a composition change. Takes effect after its own notice.
One-shot path: the full set must fit the packet (localnet ceiling is ~15).

accounts.name: creator_access_record
docs: Present when this creator has an access record. Program id when absent.

accounts.name: curator_access_record
docs: Present when this curator has an access record. Program id when absent.
When creator and curator are the same key, pass this as absent and use
`creator_access_record` — both seeds are the same account.

instructions.name: propose_targets_page
docs: Packet-safe propose: one `PAGE_LEGS` chunk per ix. Last page validates
and announces. Remaining on intermediate pages is this chunk's pools;
last page appends current `PositionPage`s then omitted held pools.

accounts.name: creator_access_record
docs: Present when this creator has an access record. Program id when absent.

accounts.name: curator_access_record
docs: Present when this curator has an access record. Program id when absent.
When creator and curator are the same key, pass this as absent and use
`creator_access_record` — both seeds are the same account.

instructions.name: register_pool
docs: Adds a pool to the curated catalogue.

accounts.name: pool_vault
docs: Typed as the core's own account, so Anchor checks the owning program and
the discriminator: registering something that is not a `stoken` vault
fails before any field is read.
Boxed, like everything else here that is not a signer or a program.
`VaultConfig`, `AssetManager` and `Pool` together are far past the 4KB
BPF stack frame, and the overflow does not appear at compile time — it
appears on-chain as an access violation with no line number (F11).

accounts.name: shares_mint
docs: Interface-typed so the same code path reads a Token-2022 shares mint if
one ever appears. Share mints stay classic SPL by design (ADR-0014).

accounts.name: escrow_asset_manager
docs: The pool's escrow. Typed against the escrow program for the same reason
as the vault.

accounts.name: asset_mint
docs: Token-2022 only: live mint whose extension layout must match params.

accounts.name: custody_readiness
docs: Token-2022 only: escrow probe record written by `probe_pool_custody`.

accounts.name: token_custody
docs: SPL path: escrow custody PDA for `params.asset_mint` (may be empty).

instructions.name: remove_pool_cctp_destination
docs: Revokes a CCTP mint recipient on a pool escrow. Governance only.

instructions.name: replace_service_role
docs: Rotates a service key, requiring the matching path to be paused first.

instructions.name: retire_position
docs: Drops an untargeted, zeroed, fully reconciled position.

instructions.name: rotate_portfolio_treasury
docs: Governance points a book's treasury at the protocol treasury.

instructions.name: set_access_record
docs: Governance: grant or revoke propose rights and the short notice for one key.

instructions.name: set_pool_status
docs: Governance may make any status transition; the guardian may only halt.

instructions.name: set_portfolio_metadata
docs: Curator updates the metadata URI, and nothing else.

instructions.name: set_rebalance_whitelist_config
docs: Governance: turn the rebalance whitelist on or off, and set the short
notice floor. 0 disables the short floor.

instructions.name: set_royalty_bounds
docs: Governance sets the global royalty floor and ceiling.

instructions.name: unpause_creation
docs: Only governance may clear it.

instructions.name: unpause_keeper_risk
docs: Only governance may clear it.

instructions.name: unpause_pool_escrow
docs: Only governance restarts it.

accounts.name: pool
docs: The registered pool, which is what binds this escrow to the catalogue.
Pausing an unregistered escrow is not this program's business.

instructions.name: update_default_oracle
docs: Changes the oracle written into new vaults.

instructions.name: update_policy
docs: Revalidates and replaces the creation policy for new portfolios.
Immediate only while `policy_delay_secs == 0` (ADR-0222).

instructions.name: update_pool_asset_mint
docs: Governance repair: set `asset_mint` to the yield token `crank_pool` must
value. Used when registration stored `shares_mint` and the crank then
ignored real escrow custody.

accounts.name: custody_readiness
docs: Token-2022: live probe record used to re-derive hook / extension fields.

instructions.name: update_pool_redemption_estimate
docs: Updates a pool's redemption-estimate floor (notice computation).

instructions.name: update_pool_reserve_ratio
docs: Updates a pool's published and monitored USDC reserve floor.

instructions.name: update_rent_margins
docs: Updates the rent margins read by the on-chain rent formulas.

instructions.name: update_vault_profile
docs: Governance: I-1 cooldowns + M-5 downside caps by class. Gated and bounded.
Zero fields keep the NOW demo inherit (`Some(1)` / `Some(5)` / 50).

instructions.name: withdraw_factory_rent
docs: Governance: return surplus `factory_authority` lamports to treasury,
keeping at least one `required_factory_rent` floor.

accounts.name: factory_authority
docs: return to treasury; the floor stays so the next create still pays.

types.name: AccessRecord
docs: Governance-owned privilege for one authority.
`can_rebalance` admits `propose_targets` while the whitelist is on.
`trusted_delay` selects `FactoryConfig.trusted_min_rebalance_delay_secs`.
The two flags are independent. A record with both false is not a grant.

types.name: Accountant
docs: Accountant program state. One instance per portfolio (and per pool vault).
The royalty / treasury split is not stored. `distribute_tokens` takes the
share for that payout and checks it against `Config` bounds.

fields.name: turnover_pending_underlying
docs: Completed rebalance sales not yet settled, in underlying units.

fields.name: turnover_fee_period_start
docs: Start of the current turnover-fee cap window.

fields.name: turnover_fee_charged_in_period
docs: Turnover fee already charged in the current window, in underlying units.

types.name: ApplyScratch
docs: Seeds: `["apply_scratch", portfolio]`.
NOTE (migration): `started_slot` was added to bound the paged-apply window.
It grows the account layout, so an existing `apply_scratch` PDA from before
the change must be closed before an upgrade (none is in flight on the current
cluster). A fresh apply re-creates it via `init_if_needed`.

fields.name: started_slot
docs: Slot the paged apply started (page 0). All pages must land within a
bounded window of it so the per-page custody facts cannot drift far.

types.name: AssetManager
docs: Per-vault asset manager instance.
Manages funds, limits, and cross-chain operations for a specific S-Token vault.

fields.name: index
docs: Unique index for this asset manager.
LAYOUT COUPLING (L-5): `huma_adapter::verify_escrow_caller` reads this
field directly from account bytes `[8..16]` (immediately after the
8-byte Anchor discriminator) to re-derive and authenticate the escrow
caller. `index` MUST remain the first field of this struct — reordering
it would silently break every adapter handshake.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed

fields.name: vault
docs: The S-Token vault this asset manager serves

fields.name: underlying_mint
docs: The vault's underlying token mint

fields.name: manager
docs: Manager authority - pause, governance proposals, emergency (manager paths)

fields.name: processor
docs: Processor authority - executes swaps, bridges, return_funds

fields.name: processor_cooldown
docs: Minimum seconds between processor operations

fields.name: processor_max_per_tx
docs: Maximum amount per processor transaction

fields.name: processor_daily_limit
docs: Daily limit for processor operations

fields.name: processor_daily_used
docs: Amount used today by processor

fields.name: last_daily_reset
docs: Timestamp of last daily limit reset

fields.name: last_operation_time
docs: Timestamp of last processor operation

fields.name: paused
docs: Whether this asset manager is paused

fields.name: force_paused
docs: Whether this pause was initiated by the authority via force_pause.
When true, only the authority can unpause (via force_unpause).

fields.name: paused_at
docs: Timestamp when paused (for emergency cooldown calculation)

fields.name: emergency_cooldown
docs: Required cooldown before emergency withdrawal (seconds)

fields.name: manager_change_cooldown
docs: Cooldown period before proposed manager can be accepted (seconds)

fields.name: pending_manager
docs: Pending manager change awaiting acceptance after cooldown

fields.name: processor_change_cooldown
docs: Cooldown period before proposed processor can be accepted (seconds)

fields.name: pending_processor
docs: Pending processor change awaiting acceptance after cooldown

fields.name: limits_cooldown
docs: Cooldown period before proposed limits can be accepted (seconds)

fields.name: pending_limits
docs: Pending limits change awaiting acceptance after cooldown

fields.name: adapter_change_cooldown
docs: Cooldown period before a proposed AdapterBinding change can be accepted (seconds).
AdapterBinding pending changes (creation via `propose_adapter`) use this
cooldown. Has a non-zero hard floor (`MIN_ADAPTER_CHANGE_COOLDOWN`) and is
itself governable via `propose_adapter_cooldown` / `accept_adapter_cooldown`.

fields.name: pending_adapter_cooldown
docs: Pending `adapter_change_cooldown` change awaiting acceptance.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Creation timestamp

fields.name: updated_at
docs: Last update timestamp

types.name: CoreProgram
docs: Which core program an admin instruction targets.

fields.name: tvl_cap
docs: From `pools.json` `tvlCapUsdc`; becomes the vault's `max_total_shares`.
That is a **share cap**, not a USDC TVL. It equals USDC only at the
initial 1.0 price; it does not track later mark-to-market TVL.

fields.name: pool_reserve_ratio_bps
docs: Headroom above the keeper's reserve target, not a TVL cap.

fields.name: factory_rent_lamports
docs: What governance transfers to `factory_authority` before the first CPI
that names it as payer. Checked against an on-chain floor, never trusted.

fields.name: volatility_class
docs: `0` inherits from `volatile` (stable / volatile). `1` = LST, `2` = volatile.

fields.name: max_execution_loss_bps
docs: Catalogue `maxExecutionLossBps`. Must be ≥ the profile downside cap (H-1).

fields.name: curator
docs: May differ from the signer. The signing creator pays for creation.
The creator-fee share goes to that signer unless the transaction
names another recipient as the last remaining account.

fields.name: rebalance_delay_secs
docs: Kept so existing create transactions still decode. Notice is global.

fields.name: deposit_fee_bps
docs: Charged on every deposit into a book created under this policy.

fields.name: withdraw_fee_bps
docs: Charged on every withdrawal from a book created under this policy.

fields.name: management_fee_bps_per_year
docs: Annual management fee written onto new books. Launch value is 0.

fields.name: turnover_fee_bps
docs: Charged on a completed rebalance sale, in bps of the sale.

fields.name: turnover_fee_cap_bps_per_period
docs: Most a book may be charged for turnover in one period, in bps of NAV.

fields.name: turnover_fee_period_secs
docs: Length of the turnover cap window, in seconds.

fields.name: max_legs
docs: Stored as `u16` so v1 can raise to 32 without a type change.
Legs live on `PositionPage` PDAs, not on this header.

fields.name: max_idle_buffer
docs: Becomes `max_total_idle` — undeployed cash only, not a TVL cap.

types.name: CreationPolicyProfile
docs: Append-only creation-policy tail on `FactoryConfig`.
Lives here — not inside `CreationPolicy` — because `policy` sits in the
middle of the account. New fields must append so a NOW-era config still
deserializes (zeros → demo inherit).

fields.name: max_price_staleness_secs
docs: Vault fuse. 0 inherits `DEMO_MAX_PRICE_STALENESS_SECS` (300).

types.name: CustodyReadiness
docs: Escrow-owned record that `register_pool` consumes for Token-2022 pools.

fields.name: readiness_hash
docs: Digest written at probe time — must equal `params.custody_readiness_hash`.

types.name: EscrowPolicy
docs: Per-asset-manager execution policy (H-3 / M-9 / L-3 / L-4).
Seeds: `[b"escrow_policy", asset_manager]`.

fields.name: enforce
docs: When false, mark-floor / bootstrap refusals become events only.
M-9 route checks still refuse.

fields.name: max_execution_loss_bps
docs: Deploy tolerance (bps) when the vault mark is usable.

fields.name: divest_allowance_bps
docs: Extra bps added on every divest (default 300).

fields.name: stale_divest_allowance_bps
docs: Extra bps added on a divest when the mark is unusable (default 200).

fields.name: divest_override_until
docs: Unix timestamp; while `now <= this`, divests use `min_amount_out` only.

fields.name: mark_max_age_secs
docs: Vault mark freshness window (default 900).

fields.name: max_swaps_per_mark
docs: Max v2 swaps that may land against one mark timestamp (default 2).

fields.name: bootstrap_cap
docs: First-deploy USDC cap while `asset_custody_before == 0`.

fields.name: bootstrap_window_secs
docs: Bootstrap window length (default 86_400).

fields.name: bootstrap_used
docs: USDC spent in the current bootstrap window.

fields.name: bootstrap_window_start
docs: Window start (unix seconds).

fields.name: allowed_output_mints
docs: Output mints a v2 swap/Kamino ix may credit (≤ 4).

fields.name: max_fee_bps
docs: L-4: CCTP `max_fee` cap in bps of `amount`. 0 = no cap.

fields.name: swaps_since_mark
docs: Swaps counted against `last_mark_ts_seen`.

fields.name: last_mark_ts_seen
docs: Last vault `last_price_update_timestamp` we counted a swap against.

types.name: FactoryConfig
docs: Account traits are hand-implemented so a shorter NOW-era body (no
`profile` tail) still deserializes. Fresh accounts are `8 + INIT_SPACE`.

fields.name: factory_tx_margin_lamports
docs: Read by `required_factory_rent()`; never sourced off-chain.

fields.name: custodian_tx_margin_lamports
docs: Read by `required_custodian_reserve()`.

fields.name: keeper_risk_paused
docs: Blocks deposits/allocate/unwind/fees; never fulfilment or return.

fields.name: deployed_risk_budget
docs: Monitoring target; hard exposure bounds are per-pool caps.

fields.name: profile
docs: I-1 / M-5. Absent on NOW-era accounts (read as zero → demo inherit).

fields.name: policy_delay_secs
docs: ADR-0222. 0 = accept is immediate. Absent on pre-0222 accounts.

fields.name: pending_governance
docs: ADR-0291 / U10. Default pubkey = none pending.

fields.name: governance_rotation_delay_secs
docs: 0 = accept is immediate (same as `policy_delay_secs`).

fields.name: trusted_min_rebalance_delay_secs
docs: Short notice floor. 0 disables it. An `AccessRecord` with
`trusted_delay` may use this instead of `policy.min_rebalance_delay_secs`.

fields.name: deprecated_trusted_creators
docs: ADR-0367 fixed slots. Unused. Bytes stay so existing configs still decode.

fields.name: rebalance_whitelist_enabled
docs: When set, `propose_targets` requires an `AccessRecord` with
`can_rebalance` for the portfolio creator or curator.
Absent on pre-whitelist accounts (read as false).

types.name: PageLeg
docs: One held pool on a `PositionPage`.
`weight_bps == 0` means exiting (in the manifest, not in current targets).

types.name: PendingAdapterCooldown
docs: Pending `adapter_change_cooldown` update awaiting acceptance after the
(current) adapter cooldown elapses.

fields.name: new_cooldown
docs: The proposed new adapter_change_cooldown (seconds)

fields.name: timestamp
docs: When this pending change was proposed (used for cooldown calculation)

types.name: PendingAdmin
docs: Pending admin change waiting for approval

types.name: PendingAdminChangeCooldown
docs: Pending admin change cooldown waiting for approval

types.name: PendingAuthority
docs: Pending authority change awaiting acceptance after cooldown

fields.name: new_authority
docs: The proposed new authority

fields.name: timestamp
docs: When this pending change was proposed (used for cooldown calculation)

types.name: PendingCooldowns
docs: Pending cooldown changes waiting for approval

types.name: PendingFees
docs: Pending fee changes waiting for approval

types.name: PendingManagerChangeCooldown
docs: Pending manager change cooldown waiting for approval

types.name: PendingPrice
docs: Pending price update waiting for approval

types.name: PendingProcessor
docs: Pending processor change awaiting acceptance after cooldown

fields.name: new_processor
docs: The proposed new processor

fields.name: timestamp
docs: When this pending change was proposed (used for cooldown calculation)

types.name: PendingRecipient
docs: A timelocked recipient change. Used for the royalty recipient and the treasury.

types.name: PendingRoles
docs: Pending roles change waiting for per-role incoming-holder claims

types.name: PendingTargets
docs: Header-only pending change. The set lives on `PendingTargetsAccount`.

types.name: PendingTargetsAccount
docs: Seeds: `["pending_targets", portfolio]`.

fields.name: turnover_underlying
docs: `expected_out` of a sale this book chose. Zero for redemption and halt exits.
Counted into `turnover_pending_underlying` only when the request closes.

types.name: PendingWhitelist
docs: Pending whitelist changes waiting for approval

types.name: PendingWithdrawalParams
docs: Pending withdrawal parameter changes waiting for approval

fields.name: redemption_estimate_secs
docs: Conservative estimate. Propose notice is at least this long.
Capped at 30 days at registration (`MAX_NOTICE_SECS`).

fields.name: risk_tier
docs: Disclosed input, not a guarantee.

fields.name: max_execution_loss_bps
docs: Atomic min-out bound; an async breach halts or quarantines the pool.

fields.name: pool_reserve_ratio_bps
docs: Published reserve target; keeper-enforced and monitored.

fields.name: risk_disclosure_hash
docs: Canonical JSON factors/assumptions served by the API.

types.name: Portfolio
docs: Portfolio header. Targets and positions live on `PositionPage` PDAs.
Task 5 breaking resize: no in-account targets/positions vecs.
Account traits are hand-implemented so a shorter append-only body (live
cluster before `book_seq`, or any later suffix) still deserializes.
Fresh accounts are `8 + INIT_SPACE` and take the full path. Discriminator,
owner, and serialize match `#[account]`.

fields.name: pending_targets
docs: Timestamps only. The proposed set is `PendingTargetsAccount`.

fields.name: deprecated_rebalance_delay_secs
docs: Unused. Bytes stay so existing portfolio headers still decode.
Notice is resolved from `FactoryConfig` and `AccessRecord` at propose.

fields.name: book_seq
docs: Bumped on apply finalize and `retire_position`. NAV pages snapshot this
so a book mutation mid-crank cannot publish a mixed-page mark.
Live snapshot. Repeats the create-time band / idle floor so a subscriber
that starts at activation still has them. `targets` is the full set when
the book is a single page; empty when paged (use `TargetsApplied` from the
last `create_portfolio_page`, or `PortfolioCreated.targets` on the inline path).
types.name: PortfolioActivated

docs: Create-time snapshot. `idle_target_bps` and `drift_band_bps` never change
after this. `targets` is the committed set on the inline path; it is empty
on a paged draft — the last `create_portfolio_page` then emits
`TargetsApplied` with the full set so drift is event-derivable either way.
types.name: PortfolioCreated
PositionPage
docs: One page of the position manifest.
Seeds: `["portfolio_page", portfolio, page_index.to_le_bytes()]`.

types.name: ProposeAdapterArgs
docs: Arguments for proposing a new AdapterBinding.

fields.name: adapter_program
docs: Adapter program ID to bind (e.g. huma_adapter's program id).

fields.name: adapter_instance
docs: Adapter-side instance PDA (e.g. HumaInstance PDA).

fields.name: native_asset_mint
docs: Mint of the native-asset side (PST/mPST/etc).

fields.name: supports_pending_withdrawals
docs: Whether the adapter exposes the deposit -> withdraw-request -> claim
lifecycle (true for Huma) vs an instant-redeem adapter (false).

types.name: ProposeLimitsArgs
docs: Arguments for proposing new limits

fields.name: processor_daily_limit
docs: New processor daily limit (None to keep current)

fields.name: processor_max_per_tx
docs: New processor max per transaction (None to keep current)

fields.name: processor_cooldown
docs: New processor cooldown in seconds (None to keep current)

fields.name: emergency_cooldown
